statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other underlying cardiac arrhythmias
The symptoms are sporadic in nature
Standard ambulatory monitoring has been insufficient for capturing the rhythm disturbances
The diagnosis codes are I48.91 and I49.9
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
